personal.note: Up to aggregate assessable income, excluding gains on investment assets. Also available to non-resident citizens.

solarPanels.note: Resident, grid-connected, own premises; capped at expenditure or loan repayments.

foreignSourceIncome.condition: Foreign-source / foreign service income received in foreign currency and remitted to Sri Lanka through a licensed bank
foreignSourceIncome.stacking: Personal relief is set against local income first (maximum benefit); local income takes the lower bands and foreign income is taxed on the bands above it, at no more than maxRate. Reproduces IRD guide Examples 2, 3 and 6.
foreignSourceIncome.foreignTaxCredit: Limited to the Sri Lankan tax on the foreign income; non-refundable; cannot be set off against other tax.
foreignSourceIncome.note: From 1 Apr 2025 such income is taxable; declare under the matching category (employment, business, investment, other).
foreignSourceIncome.source: IRD_GUIDE Annexure 7; Schedule 8 instructions; Special Note p.9

interestResident.note: Creditable against tax; the guide's Example 01 deducts it as a credit.

interestSelfDeclaration.who: Resident individuals with no taxable income for the year

capitalGains.note: Rate rises to 15% for realisations from 2026-06-03 (falls in YA 2026/27).

filing.method: e-filing mandatory; senior citizens may file on paper from YA 2025/26
filing.simplifiedReturn: Available to e-filers with only employment and interest income
filing.noReturnNeeded: Only income is employment income fully subject to APIT (plus interest <= Rs 5,000), with no instalment or final payment due — unless the CGIR has opened a file.

penalties.lateReturn: Greater of (5% of tax owing + 1% per month) or (Rs 50,000 + Rs 10,000 per month after 2026-11-30)
penalties.falseStatement: Greater of Rs 50,000 or the tax understated / refund overstated
penalties.nonFiling: Fine up to Rs 1,000,000 and/or up to 1 year imprisonment

employerAndBankDeadlines.note: Certificates must be issued free of charge (IRD_NOTICE_2026_02 s.10.5).

interestWaiver.covers: Interest on late/under-payments up to YA 2024/2025
interestWaiver.condition: Principal tax paid in full by 2026-12-02 (or already settled)

schedules.3: Investment Income (interest, rent, capital gains, dividends) -> cage 30
schedules.4: Other Income / Foreign Currency Remitted -> cage 40

returnMap.source: IRD_GUIDE Part B and schedule instructions
